frozen_canary.decision: FAIL; the current boundary seed is not authorized as a dense training target.

decision.next_execution: Freeze a more complete exact geometric boundary target on a new external scene/source, or add independent geometry-Teacher agreement; keep absent selective targets UNKNOWN.
